messages:
Ellen: Heads-up: on narrow Console heights the toast stack is creeping into the floating action area and sometimes under the right-side action panel. Screenshot attached.
Marco: Repro'd. Happens when we have 3 small toasts stacked and the FAB + side panel occupy the bottom-right.
Sana: Looks like two issues: (1) our toast offset token is too small for combined widgets, (2) toast z-index vs FAB ordering is inconsistent across pages.
Alex: Proposal: compute toast offset as the maximum of three values: default offset, fab gap, and any docked-panel occupancy. Something like `--toast-safe-offset: max(var(--toast-default,16px), calc(var(--fab-gap,16px) + 8px), var(--panel-bottom-occupancy,0px))`.
Ellen: I prefer not to force teams to change layout tokens. Runtime detection would be ideal: body gets `data-floating='fab,panel'` and our toast system resolves the var before animating.
Marco: Animation caveat: we must set the resolved CSS var before the entry animation starts or the toasts will jump. Use JS to set style var then add `--toast-entering: 1` class to trigger transition.
Sana: Accessibility notes: some toast variants were icon-only (success checkmark) with no visible text. Ensure `role=alert` and require `aria-label` on icon-only toasts. Docs should show pattern: `aria-label="Upload complete"` or include a short text node.
Alex: Also, don't change stacking order lightly. For interactive FABs the FAB should be focusable and not obstructed by transient toasts when users need to reach it. Visual priority rule: toasts above FAB unless `data-fab-priority='true'`.
Ellen: Could we add a lightweight token `toast-priority: above | below` and default to above? That gives pages an override.
Marco: Token suggestion in CSS vars: `--toast-default: 16px; --fab-gap: 16px; --panel-bottom-occupancy: 0px; --toast-computed: max(var(--toast-default), calc(var(--fab-gap) + 8px), var(--panel-bottom-occupancy))`. Also add JS fallback for older pages.
Sana: Docs copy nit: add a small section "Avoiding widget overlap" with a checklist: set `data-floating`, prefer brief toast copy, never use icon-only toasts without SR text, and test at 512px height.
design-bot: Example snippet:
```
<body data-floating="fab,panel">
  /* runtime computes --toast-computed before play */
</body>
```
Alex: I'll prototype the runtime set + Storybook story combining compact table, FAB, and docked panel. Can someone review the a11y copy?
Sana: Happy to. Checklist for PR: resolved offset on small heights, no visual jumps during animation, aria-live present and icon-only disallowed, and a Storybook visual test at 520px height.
Ellen: Thanks all — I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
